messages:
deploybot: Canary rollout initiated for release 1.4.2-rc5 -> prod-west. Preflight SBOM + vuln checks started.

deploybot: SBOM scan result: image registry.redwood/services/inference:1.4.2-rc5@sha256:abcd1234 — signature verification failed (cosign) -> holding canary.

maria.c: @alex fyi, this is blocking the canary. can you pick up?

alex: on it. which exact image/digest?

deploybot: image: registry.redwood/services/inference:1.4.2-rc5@sha256:abcd1234. sbom-scanner v1.3 reports cosign: signature missing/unverified.

alex: hmm CI did sign artifacts earlier today. checking sigstore logs now.

alex: quick heads-up — we rotated a builder node yesterday; possible cosign key wasn't mounted for that run.

priya (sec): @alex @maria.c if we can't prove the signature we should avoid a blind override. Options: pin to last-signed digest, ask infra to re-sign, or abort canary. Which is lowest customer impact?

julian: last-signed digest in prod registry is sha256:aa11bb22 and that passed staging scans. We could retarget the canary to that digest temporarily.

alex: that is fastest. note: policy requires SBOM sig present OR an explicit security exception from SecOps. we're inside normal change window.

priya (sec): I can approve a timeboxed exception if SRE confirms no image drift and we create a follow-up ticket. propose 2-hour exception.

maria.c: SRE @sara can you confirm the signed digest exists in prod-west and that nothing else changed?

sara: confirmed. digest sha256:aa11bb22 is present in prod-west registry and matches the deployed manifest we used in staging. no config diffs detected. prefer short exception vs rollback.

alex: I'll open the release-note PR to record temporary pin + investigative follow-up, then request deploybot to retarget.

deploybot: Canary retarget requested: inference-service -> image@sha256:aa11bb22. awaiting approval to proceed.

priya (sec): Approving timeboxed exception (2h). Rationale: signing system outage during build. Conditions: (1) infra files ticket to re-run signing and attach cosign proof, (2) release notes updated & audit log entry, (3) post-mortem within 48h. :white_check_mark:

maria.c: @alex go ahead. @deploybot proceed when green.

deploybot: Canary retargeted to sha256:aa11bb22 — new pods rolling. Monitoring 5m baseline for errors/latency.

julian: pinging QA — watch embeddings health and latency dashboards, tagging @qa-team.

alex: pushed release_notes/1.4.2-rc5.md with note about temporary pin and security exception. PR: https://git.redwood/release-notes/pulls/142

priya (sec): Filing security exception ticket SEC-778 with required attachments (scanner logs, cosign output, approval).

maria.c: thanks all — let's track and close the exception within 48h.
